current_episode.title: 943: What My Husband Sees That the Internet Never Will

guest.bio_context: Drew Kutcher is Jenna Kutcher's husband of 14 years and a stay-at-home father to their two daughters. He has intentionally stepped back from social media, deleting Instagram entirely, to focus on family life and personal development. He is currently engaged in individual therapy and couples coaching to work on personal growth and relationship dynamics.
